clock_comparison: Divide the absolute difference between the two SM clock medians by the earlier median.
activation: The commit that introduces this audit on origin/main. The collector requires that exact published commit.
scope: All remaining GB10 case-sessions in all cohorts. Completed sessions keep their original protocol and validity.
reason: The original 30-second range failed even after the trace settled around 77.5 C. The narrowest sampled range after 60 seconds was 3 C. Short-term fluctuations drive the range, even when adjacent window means are stable. The trend criterion measures drift and also checks SM clock stability and throttle events.

historical_replay.sm_clock_check: Unavailable. The sidecar records temperature only.
historical_replay.clock_event_check: Unavailable. The sidecar records temperature only.
historical_replay.other_timeout_sidecars: None. The five-minute collector did not save telemetry on timeout.

telemetry: Collect temperature, SM clocks, and clock-event reasons through both windows. Missing values prevent a pass. Preserve the sampled warm-up telemetry on timeout.
preserved: The model, profile, AOT, toolchain, prediction archive, and scoring rules are unchanged. Ten completed reports met the original gate and remain sealed. No GB10 label was opened for this revision.
